observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Colahome CHF40 rechargeable fan.
The box is sealed with two white plastic shipping straps.
Text on the box identifies it as an 18-inch rechargeable standing fan with a music player and solar capability.
The box mentions a 10W power rating and a 4-6 hour charge time.
The actual fan is not visible; only the illustration on the box is shown.
There is a watermark 'TOP NOTCH SYSTEM TECH' across the center of the image.

claims.claim: COLA HOME CHF40 18" Solar Rechargeable Fan

claims.evidence: The box claims a 100% pure copper motor, but the motor itself is not visible for inspection.
This refers to battery endurance or motor lifespan, which cannot be verified from a photo of a box.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, used, or damaged item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual fan outside of the packaging.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional unit for parts

risks.risk: The internal rechargeable battery may be dead or have significantly reduced capacity.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running on battery power alone for several minutes.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the solar panel or remote control may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the fan alongside all included accessories (solar panel, cables, remote).
risks.if_unproven: as a standalone fan without solar charging components

proof_requests: Photo of the actual fan out of the box.
Photo of the solar panel and all included accessories.
Video of the fan powered on and rotating at different speeds.
Photo of the back of the fan showing the technical specifications plate.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified on the packaging, allowing for a valuation. However, because the item itself is not shown, it must be priced at the worst-case scenario of a non-functional or incomplete unit.
